aluminum_structure_retrieval_subtask_mel.name: Aluminum Structure Retrieval for Melting
aluminum_structure_retrieval_subtask_mel.description: Retrieve structure of Aluminum and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

aluminum_potential_file_subtask_melting.name: Aluminum Potential File for Melting
aluminum_potential_file_subtask_melting.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Aluminum for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

aluminum_nvt_subtask_melting.name: Aluminum NVT Equilibration for melting
aluminum_nvt_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Aluminum structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, equilibrate the system under NVT conditions with the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in x, y and z direction. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure file and the final density in g/cm^3.
aluminum_nvt_subtask_melting.submission_format: {"density" : numerical value without units, "path to relaxed structure" : path} eg, {"density" : 56.00, "path to relaxed structure" : /structures/structure.dat}

aluminum_npt_subtask_melting.name: Aluminum NPT Equilibration for melting
aluminum_npt_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible nvt equilibrated Aluminum structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, relax the system under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure file and the density in g/cm^3.
aluminum_npt_subtask_melting.submission_format: {"density" : numerical value without units, "path to relaxed structure" : path} eg, {"density" : 56.00, "path to relaxed structure" : /structures/structure.dat}

aluminum_melting_npt_subtask_melting.name: Aluminum NPT Melting
aluminum_melting_npt_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible npt equilibrated Aluminum structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the melting of the equilibrated system by heating it under NPT where the temperature is gradually increased to induce melting. Report the final density in g/cm^3.
